raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted USGS NWIS “depth of well” as water-table depth and incorrectly concluded the local shallow aquifer is the North Platte River alluvium, ignoring authoritative evidence that the Ogallala Aquifer is itself a shallow water-table aquifer named for Ogallala, Nebraska. Also relied on a Perkins County well (not Keith County) to generalize, leading to the wrong final answer.
